method: For every assignment entry, reviewed the frozen title and complete ItemBody in its pinned local HTML and screenshot tiles. Individually opened each receipt-listed tile using tools.view_image at detail original. Verified assignment SHA256 values for every snapshot and HTML and receipt tile SHA256 values for every opened PNG. No production route, live site, network source, or publication state was checked.

findings.detail: Fact [F2] presents the mathematical formula phi(t)=exp(-t^2/2)/sqrt(2pi) as un-delimited plain text. The local HTML and original screenshot render the ASCII identifier, caret, and slash expression instead of typeset mathematics. The surrounding item equations are typeset normally.
findings.recommended_repair: Wrap the formula in supported inline math delimiters in the frozen source.

diagram_review.note: All 68 assigned screenshot receipts report tikz_count 0 and no KaTeX errors; no rendered diagram was present in this lane.

candidate_missing_diagrams.kind: finite birth-death transition graph with absorbing endpoints
candidate_missing_diagrams.rationale: The example defines a finite nearest-neighbor chain and explicitly identifies the absorbing set and post-hit behavior. A compact state-line diagram would make the boundary dynamics and possible interior moves immediately visible.
include: states 0,1,...,N on a line, with D={0,N} visually marked
self-loop of probability 1 at states 0 and N
for every interior state x, arrow x→x+1 labeled p and x→x−1 labeled q
note p+q=1 and all unshown transition probabilities are zero
caption that after first hit of D the chain stays at the boundary point hit
checks: for N=1, show only the two absorbing states and no interior transition arrows
for p=0 or p=1, retain the deterministic interior direction
diagram must not imply finite hitting occurs on every path; the source only states that first entrance is a hitting time and discusses the finite-hit event
candidate_missing_diagrams.status: editorial candidate; source-supported, not a confirmed defect
